// diagnostic

E0917

`#Inline(Always) fn` calls itself, directly or through other marked functions — inlining a recursive call has no fixed expansion

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` calls itself, directly or through other marked functions — inlining a recursive call has no fixed expansion

Why

`#Inline(Always)` guarantees every direct call is inlined on every tier, and a body that calls itself would be copied without end. Sema refuses each mark that can't keep the guarantee: a call of itself or a cycle of marked calls (E0917), a use as a value (E0918), a body over the size ceiling (E0919), `#Scrub` (E1016) and a read of `context.trace` (E1017)

Fix

Remove the recursion or the cycle, or relax the marker on one function of it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0917: tests/ui/inline_always_cycle.stderr.

Error [jet.RecursiveInlineAlways]: `pong` calls `ping`, whose calls lead back to `pong`, so `#Inline(Always)` cannot expand them
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_cycle.jet:5:66
    |
  5 | #Inline(Always) pong: fn(n: Int) -> Int { if n <= 0 -> 1 else -> ping(n - 1) }
    |                                                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#Inline(Always)` guarantees every call is inlined, and each inlined copy would hold the next one, so expanding the cycle would never end.
 Fix: Drop `#Inline(Always)` from one function of the cycle (use `#Inline` as a hint), or break the cycle.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0917
